title: A securities regulator sends an inquiry
summary: Preserve records, bring in securities counsel and respond fully and on time.

situation.trigger: The SEC or a state securities regulator asks for information about an offering.

outlineSteps: Log the inquiry, who sent it and the response date
Bring in securities counsel before any reply
Put a hold on records the inquiry may reach
Notify the insurance carrier if the policy covers inquiries
Gather the documents requested with counsel
Review the production with counsel before it goes
Respond fully and on time through counsel
Track follow-up requests and their deadlines
Record the outcome and any change to practice
